We need to read the problem statement carefully. It says: "Minimum Element-Sum of a Non-Complete Subset of Indices". Actually, it's asking for the minimum sum of a non-complete subset of indices. Subset of indices meaning you select some indices from 1..n. The product of every pair of its elements (the numbers at those indices) is not a perfect square. So a subset S is non-complete if for all distinct i, j in S, nums[i] * nums[j] is NOT a perfect square. (For singletons, there are no pairs, so they are vacuously non-complete. So any single element subset is non-complete.)

Goal: find the minimum sum of elements of any non-complete subset.
